blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — The dream of one day wearing a crown doesn’t have to end when a woman gets married or has children. A total of 14 women will prove they still have what it takes to be called queens as they compete in the Mrs. Cebu Philippines 2026 with a coronation on November 27 at the Waterfront Cebu City Hotel and Casino. Seven crowns are up for grabs, including the Mrs. Cebu Philippines title, currently held by Nika Linz Harris, who will represent the country at Mrs. International Global 2026 in Malaysia on October 2.
